ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Barbara A. Pollack, Chair  Andrea Eaton, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Vice Chair  Robert Gill, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Jessica Gillette, Commissioner
Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-57383  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, December 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-57384  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Director of Human
  Resources on the department's role in workforce structure, including conducting
  and/or monitoring administrative investigations, managing intake and review of
  Equal Employment Opportunity complaints, and ethics-related personnel policies.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-57385  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the City Manager’s
  Administrative Regulations initiative.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-57386  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Commission’s original
  Action Plan, as well as an update to the Office of Ethics and Transparency’s 5-
  Year roadmap.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-57387  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Policies Review.

  Page 1 of 3
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-57388  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Social Media and Campaign Activity.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-57389  Recommendation to receive and file monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Commission Responsibilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-57390  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-57391  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 26-57392  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
